class_name: 仲介-経由-ヲツウジテ類

provenance.pipeline: satsuki v1 (v1.0.1 editorial re-edit: usage-note reshaping corpus-wide, lane discrimination for same-surface families, against prompts/style.md)

patterns.usage_note: Names a route deliberately gone through to reach a goal: a person used as an intermediary on purpose (友人を通して頼む) or an experience credited with teaching something (部活を通して学ぶ). With a period noun it means all the way through (一年を通して). Its twin を通じて does the same work but sounds more written and less volitional; the two are interchangeable in most sentences.

examples.ruby: 友人[ゆうじん]を通[とお]して先方[せんぽう]に話[はなし]を伝[つた]えてもらった。
examples.english: I had a friend pass word along to them for me.

examples.ruby: 一年[いちねん]を通[とお]して気温[きおん]の変化[へんか]が少[すく]ない島[しま]だ。
examples.english: It's an island where the temperature barely shifts all year round.

examples.ruby: 部活[ぶかつ]を通[とお]して仲間[なかま]と協力[きょうりょく]する大切[たいせつ]さを学[まな]んだ。
examples.english: Being in a club taught me how much working with others matters.

glosses: by way of; through the good offices of
patterns.usage_note: Names the person, medium, or activity something passes through or comes about by way of: 報道を通じて知られる, 友人を通じて頼む, 交流を通じて理解が深まる. Its sibling lane takes a period or area and means throughout, saying a state held across a whole span (一年を通じて, 四季を通じて). を通して is the near-equivalent and is preferred when someone deliberately works through the intermediary, while を通じて usually just reports how something came about.

examples.ruby: 事件[じけん]の詳細[しょうさい]は報道[ほうどう]を通[つう]じて明[あき]らかになった。
examples.english: The details of the case came out through news coverage.

examples.ruby: 交渉[こうしょう]は仲介役[ちゅうかいやく]を通[つう]じて続[つづ]けられている。
examples.english: Talks are being carried on through an intermediary.

examples.ruby: その職人[しょくにん]の技[わざ]は動画[どうが]を通[つう]じて海外[かいがい]にも知[し]られている。
examples.english: That craftsman's skill has become known abroad as well, through video.
